text:
zoe: quick thread — prototyping a small "ribbon" that sits above the heatmap to surface sampling state, recommended actions, and quick toggles. want feedback on content, placement, and a11y.

carlos: ribbon sounds useful. can it be dismissible? sometimes it's helpful only when density is low.

mei: yes dismissible + auto-hide after user sets sampling manually. also add a small pin icon so power users can pin it.

zoe: good. concept: left side shows a compact badge e.g. "sampled 0.28/sec" (clickable for details). center shows short message when needed e.g. "Low sample density may exaggerate short spikes — increase density for accurate p95" and an action button "Adjust density". right side: tiny legend icon for bucket outlines + a keyboard hint.

rachel: copy nit: keep the ribbon line under 80 chars. suggestion: "Low sample density may exaggerate spikes. Adjust density or enable bucket markers." shorter.

hamid: accessibility: ensure ribbon is not just color-coded. Add an icon and aria-live updates when it appears/disappears. For the badge, use role="status" so screen readers get a brief announcement like "Sample rate 0.28 per second, low."

mei: keyboard: ribbon must be reachable via tab order; primary actions (Adjust density, Enable bucket markers) should be buttons. If user tabs to the badge, pressing Enter toggles the details panel.

zoe: placement question: top of heatmap (floating) vs fixed under global toolbar. floating keeps it contextual but may overlap content on small viewports. fixed keeps layout stable. Thoughts?

carlos: floating with a small offset and slide-in animation is nicer for context. on mobile it should push the heatmap down rather than overlap.

rachel: visual language: use a low-contrast background (e.g., subtle card) and a left accent color to indicate severity (amber for low). ensure contrast meets AA for text.

hamid: colorblind: don't rely on amber alone — include an alert icon (exclamation in a circle) and offer a patterned left accent for high severity when accessibility mode is enabled.

zoe: interactions for the Adjust density button: open a small popover with presets (auto, high, medium, low) and a more advanced slider. Presets should show estimated render cost: e.g. "High — more events, slower rendering". Any wording suggestions?

carlos: label presets as: Auto (recommended), High (detailed), Medium (balanced), Low (fast). put the recommendation pill on Auto.

mei: microcopy for the small cost hint: "Higher density = more raw events, may increase rendering time." keep it short and neutral.

rachel: keyboard accessible slider: support arrow keys, page up/down for larger jumps, home/end to min/max, and announce the new density in aria-valuetext like "0.5 events per second (medium)". Also include live region for the estimated p95 confidence change.

hamid: when users change density, update the heatmap with a subtle crossfade instead of a full redraw to reduce motion for sensitive users. honor prefers-reduced-motion.

zoe: good call. animation: 200ms fade for bins + 150ms for p95 line. reduced motion: instant swap.

carlos: analytics: track ribbon_shown_reason (e.g., low_density, explicit_help), ribbon_dismissed, preset_selected, slider_changed. this helps tune thresholds.

mei: threshold proposal: show ribbon when estimated sampleRate < 0.5/sec OR when p95 confidence < 40%. Use telemetry to refine.

rachel: small UX question: should the ribbon auto-suggest enabling bucket outlines when user clicks Adjust density? maybe offer a checkbox "Also show bucket outlines for exact values" in the popover.

hamid: yes but default unchecked. enabling outlines could increase visual clutter and potentially mislead non-power users. keep it opt-in.

zoe: a11y copy for the badge tooltip: "Observed sample rate for this view. Low sample rates can make short spikes appear exaggerated. Use higher density for accuracy or enable bucket outlines for exact values."

carlos: iconography: use 16px icons, keep touch targets 44px. mobile popover becomes full-screen sheet.

mei: include an aria-describedby on the heatmap that references the ribbon when it's visible so assistive tech knows why fidelity might be reduced. e.g., aria-describedby="heatmap-ribbon-desc" with text from the ribbon.

rachel: testing: include a screenreader test scenario in the QA checklist: open dashboard with low sample rate, ensure ribbon announced, tab to Adjust density, open popover, change preset, confirm heatmap announcement.

zoe: i'll mock two visual treatments: (1) slim floating ribbon with badge + icon + inline action, (2) compact fixed ribbon under toolbar. will include mobile sheet flows and reduced-motion variant. i'll attach gifs.

design-bot: reminder: add accessibility checklist and analytics keys to the PR description.

zoe: thanks all — final decision in the review: prefer floating ribbon with dismiss/pin, aria-live announcements, presets + advanced slider, opt-in bucket outline checkbox. i'll post mocks by EOD. :sparkles:
